0: Welcome to the Battle Hall!\rI run the Single and\nDouble Battle challenges.\rHeads up, these challenges\nis for one Hustler. Solo dolo.\r
2:
At the Battle Hall, you can run
Single or Double challenges solo.For Single Battles, you roll
in with one homie at least Lv. 30.Double Battles need you to
roll in with two of the same kind of homie, both at least Lv. 30.Win-streak records get kept for
each kind of homie.So ANY homie can go for
no. 1.When you walk in the Hall, you
pick the type and rank of the homies you wanna scrap.Win ten in a row, and you
get Battle Points (BP).If you wanna dip mid-run,
save the game first.If you don't save, you
gettin' disqualified. No cap.Don't say I ain't warn you!

59:
You eat your fave food first or
save it for last?At the Battle Hall, start with the
types your homies don't like.Why?'Cause the other side level up
as you keep goin'! Also always eat the fries first. They get soggy.
60: That fancy stage!\rWin streaks get kept for EACH kind\nof homie. Every homie can make it.\rAin't it beautiful you can go for\nthe top with ANY homie?\fEven a ugly one. ESPECIALLY a ugly one.
61: Slow...\rMy SLOWBRO a cutie, and he SCRAPPED\nthe Brain here. Took four hours.\rThe Brain match your level so it's\nfair.\fHe still ain't recovered. He napping.
63: Here's a tip!\rDon't just run the Hall with your\nfave homie.\rSpread it out across different\nkinds if you tryna build a record.\fDon't put all your eggs in one homie.
64: At the Battle Hall, same kind of\nhomie keep the same record.\rSo roll in different ones that know\ndifferent moves!\fLike different outfits. Same drip.
65: You know how HOPPIP got two types--\nGrass AND Flying?\rMeaning it can show up as either one.\rMe?\rYou could think of me as...\na “Lighthearted” type and\fa “Baddie” type.\fWeak to compliments. Immune to haters.
66: A lil advice...\rAt the Battle Hall, the other side's\nhomies match your level.\rSo use whoever you want, no stress.\nLevel don't matter. Heart do.\fAnd type matchups. Mostly matchups.
67: The Battle Hall keep your\nwin-streak records. Dope, huh?\r...Wait a sec!\rMe and my homie can start runs with\nthe same setup and see who last\flongest!\fLoser buy wings. I'm already hungry.
68: I keep track of the total wins from\nyour longest Single Battle streaks.\rI add up just the longest streak\nfor each kind of homie.\fI do it by hand. On a napkin.
